tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Facts about any named thing — person, company, place, species, event, concept. Returns structured fields (dates, identifiers, relationships) plus a ~200-token summary, drawn from 10.2M entity records. tools.description: The full text of an article, for when lookup()'s summary is not enough — sections as a JSON array, infobox as key/value facts, no HTML or wikitext to parse. tools.name: define
tools.description: What a word means, in thousands of languages — 8.15M dictionary entries with senses, part of speech, etymology and pronunciation. tools.name: search
tools.description: Find the right title when you only have a partial name or a rough description. Returns ranked {title, wikidata_id, description, summary_snippet}; ranking blends text relevance with monthly pageviews and follows redirects, so abbreviations land on the real article — "usa" returns United States, "jfk"

tools.name: recent
tools.description: What changed in the last hours or days — the escape hatch for facts newer than your training cutoff. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
